name: Gen1BattleUI
description: The battle command and move menus as four buttons in a 2x2 grid instead of a list, inside the Game Boy's own screen and the Game Boy's own chrome. FIGHT, PKMN, ITEM and RUN each get a box of their own; so do the four moves, with a panel above carrying the highlighted move's full name, its PP, and its type on a chip in that type's colour. Opening the bag leaves the buttons up and marks ITEM with a hollow hand. Dialogue still takes the bottom of the screen back for as long as it is talking. Both battle layouts, CLASSIC and WIDE.
